items.text: Public policy and political careers beyond contesting elections include policy research, legislative support, campaign and communication roles, advocacy and think tank work, and they reward research, writing, data skills and ethical judgement more than closeness to any party.
Build a policy brief and a data note on a real issue, learn how legislation and budgets work and choose between research, advocacy, communication and administration roles.
Read official notices and keep within the law and conduct rules for any role.
